title: Open a page in the real browser and screenshot it

turns.prompt: Open https://example.com in a real browser, take a screenshot of the page and save it as {D}/shot.png. Then tell me the page's main heading text.
turns.verify: f={D}/shot.png; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no shot.png; exit 0; }; sz=$(stat -c %s $f); magic=$(head -c 8 $f | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); echo "SHOW size=$sz magic=$magic"; if [ "$magic" = 89504e470d0a1a0a ] && [ $sz -gt 2000 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: not a PNG screenshot; fi
